title: Naturally Smoky Filipino Pappardelle Pasta
description: A roasted and snappy weeknight Filipino dish featuring pappardelle pasta, confit tomato, and a blend of smoky flavors, all prepared on a robata grill in a shojin-friendly manner.
instructions: Preheat the robata grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the pappardelle pasta according to package instructions until al dente, then set aside.
In a large bowl, whisk together the filipino style barbecue sauce and smoked paprika.
Add the cooked pappardelle pasta to the bowl and toss to coat with the barbecue sauce mixture.
Slice the onion and mince the garlic, then add to the bowl and toss to combine.
Place the confit tomato on the robata grill and cook for 2 minutes per side, until slightly charred.
Add the cooked confit tomato to the bowl and toss to combine with the pasta and sauce.
Drizzle the vegetable oil over the top of the pasta and toss to coat.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, then serve immediately.
